title: Relevance can notice an old conflict without earning permission to bring it back
body: A provisional Resurfacing Authority Envelope now separates machine-noticed relevance from learner authority to return retained context to the foreground. Fourteen deterministic cases accept quiet retention, a scoped learner watchpoint, and an explicit learner request while rejecting relevance-as-authority, machine scoring as action authority, machine-authored watchpoints, scope leakage, person-wide defaults, automatic session carry, inferred human availability, interruptive resurfacing, and raw-dialogue copying. The semantic suite passed 14/14 locally. The connected repository safety layer blocked promotion to main during this cycle, so the contribution remains staged on the daily-build branch and product remains v0.1.0.

waitAMinute.summary: The same split keeps recurring: noticing is not interrupting, remembering is not restoring authority, TurtleAsk formation is not permission to surface, persistence is not foregrounding, and relevance is not resurfacing authority. This may be a reusable proposal/authority invariant rather than a new CTC domain.
